content: Ketsutsi kememɨtemienikekai
Merikɨte kepauka Ketsutsi mɨtiutahayewaxɨ mɨpaɨ tiwakuxaxatɨwatɨ, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yuhetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete:
«Xeme mɨpaɨ xepɨtemateri, huta tukari peuyewetse Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari maye'anikɨ, meta Yuri Tewi nehɨkɨtɨtɨ nekaniyetuiyamɨkɨ kuruxitsie nemɨmierienikɨ».
Hikɨ 'ana mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta teɨteri wa'ukiyarima mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame Kaipatsi mɨtitewakai hetsɨa,
mekaniuyu'enieni, Ketsutsi memɨwiyakɨ me'i'itame mɨpaɨ memɨte'imienikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Xeikɨa 'ixɨarari xuawekaku hawaikɨ, teɨteri me'uyeha'anikɨ waɨkawa me'uyukuxeɨrienikɨ».
Witsimu'ɨa kemɨtiukawiriyarie Ketsutsi
Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi Wetaniya kiekariyaritsie kaniukateitɨni, Tsimuni hetsɨa meripaitɨ nawi kwiniyayari mexeiyakai hetsɨa,
hikɨ 'uka mana kaninuani tete puteyuyari witsimɨ'ane 'ahanatɨ witsimu'ɨa 'ayemakame kwinimieme mɨraye'axe, hikɨ kaneitituani Ketsutsi mu'uyatsie mexi mexatsie 'utikatei.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete me'uneniereka mekaniuyeha'ani mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —¿Titayarikuta yakɨ xeikɨa mɨkɨ pɨreuyewe?
Pɨyɨwekai mɨkɨ witsimu'ɨa waɨkawamekɨ mutuiyanikekai, tuminiyari memɨmikienikɨ tixaɨtɨ memɨkateheuxeiya.
Ketsutsi retimaika kememutiyuanekai, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Titayari xete'i'uximatɨa 'ikɨ 'ukaratsi? 'Aixɨa katiniuyurieni nehetsiemieme.
'Uxa'atɨni warie 'amekaniu'uwakuni tixaɨtɨ memɨkateheuxeiya xehetsɨa, peru ne xehetsɨa 'anepɨka'uyeikani 'uxa'atɨni warie.
Kemɨreititua witsimu'ɨa nehetsie, netsikuha'aritɨwatɨ katiniuyurieni nemɨkateukienikɨ.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, tsepanetɨ hakewa 'ikɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekuxaxatsiwani naitsarie kwiepa, kanitaxatsiemɨkɨ kana'eriwamɨkɨ 'ikɨ 'uka kemɨtiuyuri.
Kura kemɨtiuyuwaɨri Ketsutsi mɨyetuanikɨ
Xewitɨ tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta mɨwanɨkai, Kura 'Itsikariutitanaka mɨtitewakai, kaneyani mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete wahetsɨa.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Kepaɨmeme xepɨnetsi'ɨitɨani, neta Ketsutsi nekanixeyetuiriemɨkɨ? Mɨkɨ me'uyu'enieka xeitewiyari heimana tamamata pɨrata tuminiyari mekani'ɨitɨani.
'Ana kanitsutɨani tikuwaunetɨ kepauka 'aixɨa mɨyɨnikekai mɨwayetuirienikɨ.
Ti'aitame 'ikwaiya

Hikɨ mexɨakame tukaritsie Paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka 'ixɨarariyaritsie, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete Ketsutsi 'aurie mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni, mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Hakewa matsihenake 'aixɨa temɨtehekuyurienikɨ, Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari pemekwanikɨ?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xeime hetsɨa xekenehu kiekaritsie, mɨpaɨ xeketenetahɨawi: «Ti'ɨkitame mɨpaɨ paine: “Netukari kaneutihuraniri, 'akiita Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari nepɨwewieni nehetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahamatɨa”».
Hikɨ Ketsutsi kemɨtiwaruta'aitɨa yamepɨte'uyuri, 'aixɨa mepikuyuri Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari.
Hikɨ 'ukuyɨreku mexatsie kaniutiyerɨni tamamata heimana yuhutame wahamatɨa.
Mexi metekwakai, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, xewitɨ xeme pɨnetsiyetuani.
Hikɨ kwinimieme meteyuhiwerietɨ yuxexuitɨ mɨpaɨ metenitihɨawetɨkɨne: —¿Ne netihɨkɨ, Ti'aitame?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xewitɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni nehamatɨa paa manati'ɨwe xakɨtsie, mɨkɨ kaneniyetuamɨkɨ.
Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa, nepɨyemie nemɨmierienikɨ kemɨre'uxa nehepaɨtsita, perutsɨ xɨa'ui kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiyetuani Yuri Tewi nehɨkɨtɨme. Matsi 'aixɨa kani'anenikeyu xɨka ka'utinuiwake mɨkɨ tewi.
Hikɨ miyetuanikekai Kura mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —¿Ti'ɨkitame, ne netihɨkɨ? Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Ekɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ pekanaineni.

Hikɨ metekwakaku Ketsutsi paa kananuku'ɨni, 'aixɨa 'utayɨka Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita paa hepaɨtsita, kanititara kaniwarumini teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete, mɨpaɨ tiwakɨhɨawetɨ: —Xekenanu'ɨi meta xekeneutikwa'i, 'ikɨ kaninewaiyaritɨni.
'Ariketa tekɨxi kananukuhana, pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨaka Kakaɨyari, kaniwaru'itɨani mɨpaɨ tiwakɨhɨawetɨ: —Yunaitɨ xekenanuti'iexɨa 'ikɨ.
'Ikɨ kaninexuriyatɨni, mɨkɨ tɨratu mɨhekwa 'aixɨa kaniyurimɨkɨ Kakaɨyari meta yuteɨterima wahamatɨa mieme. Yumɨireme wahetsiemieme kanitayeurimɨkɨ memɨteheuyehɨwiyarienikɨ ke'axamemɨte'uyurikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, tawari hawaikɨ nepɨka'enu'ieni 'ikɨ kaxie hayari, 'arikekeri tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka hekwamekɨ nemenu'ieni kaxie winuyari mɨhekwa xehamatɨa ne'ukiyari mɨra'aitatsie.
Hikɨ nɨawari Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme me'utikwikaka, mekanekɨne yemuritsie Huriwu Mati'u.
Ketsutsi kemutayɨ Pekuru kemɨtiyuku'imawanikekai
Mana Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —'Ikɨ tɨkaritsie, xeme yunaitɨ xepɨnetsiku'eirieni, mɨpaɨ mɨre'uxakɨ:
Peru ne'anukukeme, ne meri nepɨyemie Karereyatsie paitɨ».
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Tsepanetɨ yunaitɨ memɨmatsi'uku'eiri, ne hawaikɨ nepɨkakunuani.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨmarahɨawe, 'ikɨ tɨkaritsie wakana 'ukiri katahiwawekaku 'akuxi, 'ekɨ haikakɨa pepɨ'aku'imawani, kename pekanetsimate pe'utaitɨ.
Pekuru tawari mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Tsepanetɨ meuyeweka 'ahamatɨa nemɨmierieni, nepɨkaneku'imawani kename nekamatsimate ne'utaitɨ. Meta hipatɨta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yaxeikɨa mekaniutiyuani.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuyutanenewi Ketitsemani mɨrayetewatsie
Hikɨta Ketsutsi teyu'ɨkitɨwamete warawitɨtɨ kaneyani Ketitsemani reyetewakaku. Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «'Ena xekenekuteni mexi huma nepɨyunenewimie».
Pekuru meta Tsewereu niwemama yuhutame kaniwarewitɨni mana paitɨ, hikɨ kanitsutɨani yuhiwerietɨ yu'iyaritɨatɨ.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Ne'iyaritsie kwini mieme nekaninehiwerieka, mɨkɨkɨ nekanimɨximeni. 'Ena xekeneuyuhayewa meta xekenayeneniereni nehamatɨa».

'Etsiwa huma 'uyaka kaniutihɨximakeni, kaniyutanenewieni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Ne'ukiyari, xɨka tɨma tiyɨwenike, yanepɨra'eriwakaku mɨka'aye'anikɨ kenemɨtikwinitɨarieni. Peru kemɨnetinake ne pɨkatixaɨ, 'ekɨ pɨta kemɨmatinake».
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mematitekaitsie kaninuani, kaniwarutaxeiya mekutsume. Mɨpaɨ Pekuru katiniutahɨawe: «¿'E'e xekateyɨwawekai tsikere xeihurayari xemayeneniereni nehamatɨa?
Xekenetaneniereni, xekeneyunenewieka kapa 'axaxete'uyurienikɨ xemɨta'inɨatsienitsie. Xe'iyari kaniyuwaɨriyani, peru xewaiyari matsi puwerani».
Hikɨ hutarieka heyaka kaniyutanenewieni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Ne'ukiyari, xɨka heuyeweka mɨpaɨ nemɨtikwinitɨarieni, kemɨmatinake yaketiuyɨni».
Tawarita kepauka munua, kaniwarutaxeiyata mekutsume, memɨkayɨwawekaikɨ memayeneniereni kutsikɨ.
Hikɨ kaniwaruku'eirieni, tawari heyaka hairieka kaniyutanenewieni yaxeikɨa 'utaitɨ.

Tawarita kaninuani teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mematitekaitsie, nuaka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «¿Xetekutsu 'akuxi, xete'uxipie? Neuxei, kanaye'aximeniri, Yuri Tewi kenemɨtihɨkɨ, nemɨyetuiyani 'axateyuruwamete wahetsɨa.
Xekenanuku'uti, kɨmɨtɨkari. Kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiyetuani mana kanamieni».
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuwiyarie

Merikɨte 'utaniukakaku 'akuxi Kura mana kaninuani, tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta mɨwanɨkai. Yuwaɨkawame teɨteri yuhamatɨa kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni 'ixiparate meta kɨyexi mete'u'ɨkame, mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta teɨteri wa'ukiyarima mewareyenɨ'aku.
'Iya miyetuanikekai 'inɨari pɨwarutaxatɨakai, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Kemɨ'ane nemɨtawaɨritɨani 'itsiyakɨ, mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨkamɨkɨ, xekenewiya».
Hikɨ Ketsutsi hetsɨa nuaka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ke'aku Ti'ɨkitame. Hikɨ kani'itseni.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nehamiku, kepemɨtikuyuriene yaketineuyuri. Hikɨ teɨteri 'auriena me'aketɨkɨneka, Ketsutsi mekaniuwiya.
Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi hamatɨa memu'uwakai xewitɨ kaniwatihana yu'ixipara, ti'uximayatame mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa mieme, nakaya kanawiteni.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Keneuka'uta 'a'ixipara, karikɨ yunaitɨ 'ixiparakɨ memɨteyumemiwa, 'ixiparakɨta mekanikwi'iwakuni.
Kari mɨpaɨ pepɨkatimate, ne nekaniyɨweni nemitawawirieni ne'ukiyari, miriyari meyupaɨmeme niuki tuayametemama mɨkɨta kwitɨwa kaniwaranɨ'aweni.
Peru xɨka mɨpaɨ netiuyurieni, ¿kehepaɨ raye'ani 'utɨarika meuyewetse 'ipaɨ mɨtiyɨni manuyɨne?

Hikɨ 'ana Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe teɨteri: —¿Kari xepeyekɨ 'ixiparate meta kɨyexite xete'u'ɨtɨ xenetsiwiyake, kemɨtiwiwiyarɨwa tinawayame? Mɨixa tukita nenayekateitɨni tukarikɨ neti'ɨkitatɨ, 'ana xepɨkanetsi'uwi.
Peru naitɨ 'ikɨ mɨya pɨtiyɨni, maye'anikɨ Kakaɨyari niukametemama kememutiyua 'utɨarika xapayaritsie. Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yunaitɨ mekaniku'eirieni meta mekaniyuta'una.
Ketsutsi 'itsɨkate wahɨxie
Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi memuwiyaxɨ Kaipatsi hetsɨa mekani'atɨani, mɨkɨ mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, hetsɨana mekaniyuxeɨriekaitɨni 'inɨarikɨ te'ɨkitamete meta 'ukirawetsixi.
Peru Pekuru kaniweiyakaitɨni yatewa mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame kiita paitɨ. Muwa kaneutahani tukita tehɨwemete wa'aurie kanayerɨni niereke kemɨ'itɨarienikekai.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta 'itsɨkate yunaitɨ mekaniwawautɨwekaitɨni hipame memunenierixɨ memɨte'itani Ketsutsi hepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ hetsiena memɨte'ahɨanikɨ memita'aitakɨ mɨmierienikɨ.
Peru mepɨyutatexi, tsepa yumɨiretɨ wahetsɨa memu'axɨa me'i'itatɨ. 'Imatɨrieka yuhutatɨ mekaniu'axɨani,
mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —'Ikɨ mɨpaɨ putayɨ: “Ne nekaniyɨweni nemika'una Kakaɨyari tukieya, tawarita netitawewiwe hekwamekɨ haika tukari”.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame 'anukukeka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Pekatitaniuni 'ahepaɨtsita? ¿ketitayari mɨya mete'utiyuane 'ikɨ 'ahepaɨtsita?
Peru Ketsutsi 'atsipɨkahainekai. Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kakaɨyari mayeniere matsi'eniekaku yaketatineutahɨawi xɨka Kɨritsitu pehɨkɨtɨni, Kakaɨyari nu'aya.

Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Metsɨ 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ pekanaineni. Peru ne mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe: 'Uxa'atɨni xekanenixeiyakuni Yuri Tewi kenemɨtihɨkɨ, 'ane'akaime Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye tserieta, meta haitsata ne'akamiekame taheima.

Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame yukamixa kaneukatsana mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ karima: —Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita 'axaputayɨ. Tawari tepɨkawareuyehɨwa memunenierixɨ. Neuxei, xeme hikɨ xepi'eni, Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita 'axaputayɨ.
¿Kexeteku'eriwa 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Peuyewetse mɨmierieni.
Hikɨ mekaniti'aɨtsikawiyatɨkɨne hɨxitana meta mekanitihutsutɨkɨne. Hipatɨta 'auritapana mekaneitiwayakaitɨni
mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Ketatineutaxatɨa, Kɨritsitu, ¿kemɨ'ane pɨmatsiheutiwa?
Pekuru kemɨtiyuta'ima kename Ketsutsi kamate 'utaitɨ
Mexi mɨyatiyɨanekai, Pekuru takwa kaniukateitɨni, hikɨ ti'uximayatame hetsɨana nuaka 'ɨimaritɨtɨ, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Ekɨtatsiere Ketsutsi Karereya kiekame hamatɨa pekaniuyeikakaitɨni.
Peru mɨkɨ kaniyuta'imani yunaime wahɨxie mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Atsinepɨkatimate kehapaɨtɨtɨ pemɨnerahɨawe.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ kaneyani kitenie hepa, xewitɨta kanixeiya 'uka, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe mana memɨti'ukai: —'Ikɨtatsiere Ketsutsi natsaretitanaka hamatɨa kaniuyeikakaitɨni.
Peru mɨkɨ tawarita kaniyuta'imani, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Kakaɨyari netsi'eniekaku nepaine, nepɨka'imate mɨkɨ tewi.
Hikɨ yareutewikaku mana memɨti'ukai hurawa me'akɨneka mɨpaɨ Pekuru mekateniutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ 'ekɨ xewitɨ mɨkɨ wa'iwa pekanihɨkɨtɨni, pepɨmatsiɨkɨ kepemɨtiuniuka.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kakaɨyari 'axakenetiupitɨani xɨka netiku'itawani, nepɨka'imate mɨkɨ tewi nepaine. Hikɨ 'ana yapauka kanetahiwa wakana.

Pekuru Ketsutsi niukieya kanaye'erieni kemɨtitahɨawixɨ: «Wakana katahiwawekaku 'akuxi, 'ekɨ haikakɨa pepɨ'aku'imawani kename pekanetsimate pe'utaitɨ». Hikɨ 'anuyeyaka kaniutatsuani kwinimieme tiyuhiwerietɨ.
